title: ImageryHeader
description: Sidecar (web/public/data/imagery/{region}.json) for imagery/{region}.webp, an orbital image texture for the 3D south-pole patch. The WebP is RGB with the same grey value in every channel. Image axes: column 0 is x_min and columns grow with +x; row 0 is y_max (north-up, the usual image convention), so rows grow with -y. This is the OPPOSITE row direction to the x0/y0 raster convention in common.schema.json. Pixels are areas: pixel (col, row) spans x in [x_min + col * pixel_m, x_min + (col + 1) * pixel_m] and y in [y_max - (row + 1) * pixel_m, y_max - row * pixel_m].

attribution.description: Credit line to show wherever the image is displayed (no units).

region.description: Region id (no units); equals the file name.

x_min.description: Projected x in metres of the left edge of column 0.

x_max.description: Projected x in metres of the right edge of the last column.

y_min.description: Projected y in metres of the bottom edge of the last row.

y_max.description: Projected y in metres of the top edge of row 0.

pixel_m.description: Pixel size in projected metres, the same along x and y: (x_max - x_min) / width.

width.description: Image width in pixels (columns along +x); unitless count.

height.description: Image height in pixels (rows along -y); unitless count.

row0.description: Which y edge image row 0 sits on (no units): always y_max (north-up).

nodata.description: Grey value (0-255, no units) meaning no imagery (shadowed gaps or no coverage), or null when every pixel is valid.

webp_quality.description: Lossy WebP quality used (0-100, no units).

source_level.description: WMTS tile matrix level the pixels were read from (no units).

source_pixel_m.description: Pixel size in metres of the source tiles at source_level; pixel_m >= this (never upsampled).
